globalAttributes.description: On <html>: swap the body in place on navigations between opted-in pages.

globalAttributes.name: data-ui-persist
globalAttributes.description: Keep this element's live DOM, state and scroll offsets across in-page navigations; its links take aria-current from the next page. The value is an id both pages share.

globalAttributes.description: Render this element from the next page but keep its scroll offset across in-page navigations (a section sidebar, a table of contents). The value is an id both pages share.
